scope: Unit batch-2 protocol research draft (task-18). Proposal only: not merged into platform/units/catalog.json and not runtime admission. Entries mirror the existing catalog entry shape; evidence URLs are official product pages, the official I2C address index and official m5stack/uiflow-micropython drivers anchored at snapshot 528edd8 (V2.1.5). All defaults are synthetic test-fixture values.

units.name: Unit Joystick

chips.part: MEGA328P (visual inventory name only; original U024 not in official I2C index)

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: At 0x52, read three bytes from register 0x52: X raw, Y raw, button raw. X/Y are 0..255; get_x/get_y subtract 128 (optional swap); get_button_status() is bool(buffer[2]).
gaps: Official I2C index lists only U024-C (MEGA8A @0x52); original U024 chip identity unresolved.
Button byte polarity is not verified beyond bool() semantics.
0x52 conflicts with registered joystick-v11 (one Unit per bus).

runtime.required_data_plane: SoC I2C controller transactions to the existing CONTROL_JOYSTICK register snapshot at 0x52; reuse m5_unit_i2c_controls.c

units.blocker: Runtime implementation needs the 'joystick' id mapped to CONTROL_JOYSTICK and device-local evidence; 0x52 conflicts with registered joystick-v11 (one Unit per bus). Original U024 MCU identity and button polarity remain unresolved.
units.input_semantics: Synthetic raw X/Y/button bytes delivered through the controller-visible I2C register snapshot.
units.output_semantics: Observed guest I2C reads and address probes; no output transitions.
limitations: All default values are synthetic UI/test fixtures, not measured hardware defaults.
This catalog entry alone does not authorize a simulated or functional-PASS claim.
Mechanical travel, potentiometer linearity and button feel are not modeled.

units.name: Unit DAC

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: MCP4725 at 0x60: 2-byte fast-mode write [0b0000|val>>8, val&0xFF]; 3-byte read where DAC value=(buf[1]<<4)|(buf[2]>>4); 3-byte EEPROM write [0x60|val>>8, (val>>4)&0xFF, (val<<4)&0xFF].
gaps: EEPROM write timing/endurance/power-loss retention not modeled.
Read status byte (POR/EEPROM bits) is ignored by the driver; model value needs a documented constant.

runtime.required_data_plane: SoC I2C controller transactions to a device-local bare-command slave: 2-byte fast-mode writes and 3-byte reads

units.blocker: Runtime implementation needs a CONTROL_DAC branch with a 3-byte read response and EEPROM command observation; EEPROM retention and analog output voltage are not modeled.
units.input_semantics: Synthetic 12-bit DAC code fixture written by the guest through fast-mode/EEPROM commands.
units.output_semantics: Observed guest-to-Unit writes and readback of the latched DAC code; analog voltage is derived, not measured.
limitations: All default values are synthetic UI/test fixtures, not measured hardware defaults.
This catalog entry alone does not authorize a simulated or functional-PASS claim.
Analog output accuracy, reference drift, EEPROM retention and load behavior are not modeled.

units.name: Unit Watering

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: Pump enable on yellow (Pin(port[1])) driven high for on(); soil-moisture analog output on white (Pin(port[0])) read via ADC ATTN_11DB with read_u16()/read_uv().
gaps: PUMP_EN active polarity comes from on()→value(1) in the driver; the page only labels PUMP_EN.
ADC 11DB attenuation full scale/calibration is not stated on the product page.
Pump electrical/moisture physics are not modeled.

runtime.required_data_plane: SoC GPIO controller: white ADC sample injection through m5_unit_adc_sample and yellow GPIO output observation through a pad observer

units.blocker: Runtime implementation needs a 'watering' GPIO branch that combines ADC input on white with pad-output observation on yellow; pump electrical/flow and soil-moisture physics are not modeled.
units.input_semantics: Synthetic soil-moisture millivolt fixture delivered through the SoC ADC controller sample path.
units.output_semantics: Observed guest-driven yellow pad level (pump enable); no pump physics.
limitations: All default values are synthetic UI/test fixtures, not measured hardware defaults.
This catalog entry alone does not authorize a simulated or functional-PASS claim.
Pump current, head/flow, soil moisture curve and ADC calibration are not modeled.

units.name: Unit Fader

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: White wire is a 0-3.3V potentiometer output read by ADC10 ATTN_11DB read_u16(); yellow drives 14 SK6812 RGB LEDs (SK6812 ORDER=(1,0,2,3) => G,R,B, 800kHz timing 400/850/800/450ns). update_color() maps ADC raw to a 256-entry palette.
gaps: SK6812 timing tolerance is not modeled beyond the driver timing constants.
Master driver changes set_brightness() buffer rescaling; the snapshot and master produce different frame bytes after fill_color()+set_brightness().
Potentiometer linearity/mechanical feel and LED optics are not modeled.

runtime.required_data_plane: SoC GPIO/ADC for the white wire plus SoC RMT capture on the yellow wire; reuse the existing ADC and RGB branches of m5_unit_gpio.c in one Unit

units.blocker: Runtime implementation needs a 'fader' GPIO branch that combines ADC input and a 14-LED RMT output endpoint; the snapshot-vs-master set_brightness() divergence must be resolved by pinning one driver SHA. Potentiometer mechanics and LED optics are not modeled.
units.input_semantics: Synthetic potentiometer millivolt fixture delivered through the SoC ADC controller sample path.
units.output_semantics: Observed guest-driven SK6812 RMT frames (G,R,B per LED) and frame counters; optical output not modeled.

This catalog entry alone does not authorize a simulated or functional-PASS claim.
LED colorimetry, brightness, timing tolerance and slider mechanics are not modeled.

units.name: Unit Mini BPS

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: BMP280 at 0x76: chip id 0xD0=0x58, reset 0xE0=0xB6, status 0xF3, control 0xF4, config 0xF5, calibration 0x88 (24 bytes), data 0xF7 (6 bytes); measure() reads 6 data bytes and applies the 24-byte calibration. The driver falls back to QMP6988 (0x70) when scan()[0] is not 0x76.
gaps: Product page documents BMP280 only but the driver also accepts QMP6988; the probe uses scan()[0] order and can mis-detect.
Official I2C index lists U090-B Mini BPS v1.1 as QMP6988 @0x56, which does not match the driver fallback 0x70.
Calibration coefficients are synthetic fixtures, not factory values; the guest-side compensation formula is the driver implementation.

claims: QMP6988 register map and 25-byte OTP calibration

runtime.required_data_plane: SoC I2C controller transactions to a device-local BMP280 register-file slave; data registers carry raw counts consistent with the synthetic calibration and fixtures

units.blocker: Runtime implementation needs a US_BMP280 register-file kind (chip id/reset/control/config/calibration/data) whose raw data registers are inverse-compensated from the temperature-c/pressure-pa fixtures so the guest-side driver math matches. The QMP6988 variant (U090-B 0x56 vs driver 0x70) remains unresolved and must not be inferred.
units.input_semantics: Synthetic temperature/pressure fixtures encoded into the model's raw data registers using the same compensation coefficients.
units.output_semantics: Observed guest I2C register transactions; compensated values are computed guest-side by the official driver.
limitations: All default values are synthetic UI/test fixtures, not measured hardware defaults.
This catalog entry alone does not authorize a simulated or functional-PASS claim.
Barometric accuracy, calibration authenticity, altitude sea-level assumption and QMP6988 variant support are not validated.

units.name: Unit ENV

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: ENV-I combines DHT12 at 0x5C (read 5 bytes from 0x00: humidity int/dec, temperature int with sign bit7/dec, checksum = (b0+b1+b2+b3)&0xFF) and BMP280 at 0x76 (chip id 0xD0=0x58, data 0xF7 6 bytes, calibration 0x88 24 bytes). ENVUnit requires an explicit type argument; ENV-I selects this pair.
gaps: The product page temperature accuracy contradicts itself (+/-0.2C spec vs +/-0.5C comparison table); accuracy is not modeled.
The driver requires an explicit type argument and never auto-detects ENV-I/II/III/IV.
Product page is EOL and absent from the official I2C index; addresses come from the page comparison table and drivers.

claims: DHT12 0x5C + BMP280 0x76 address table and ranges
BMP280 register map and calibration read

runtime.required_data_plane: SoC I2C controller transactions to two device-local slaves (DHT12 0x5C + BMP280 0x76) under one Unit attachment

units.blocker: Runtime implementation needs a multi-slave Unit attachment (DHT12 + BMP280 on one attachment) in m5_unit_runtime.c plus a US_DHT12 register-file kind with a valid checksum. ENV-II/III/IV variants are not claimed.
units.input_semantics: Synthetic temperature/humidity/pressure fixtures encoded into DHT12 and BMP280 device-local registers.
units.output_semantics: Observed guest I2C transactions to both addresses; decoded physical values are guest-side driver output.
limitations: All default values are synthetic UI/test fixtures, not measured hardware defaults.
This catalog entry alone does not authorize a simulated or functional-PASS claim.
Sensor accuracy, calibration, self-heating and ENV-II/III/IV variants are not modeled.

units.name: Unit ADC v1.1

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: ADS1110 at 0x48: one-byte config write (bit7 ST/DRDY start, bit4 single-shot, bit3:2 data rate, bit1:0 PGA), then read 2 bytes big-endian signed. The driver converts with raw*2.048/2**(mini_code-1)/gain/divider where divider=100/610.
gaps: Product page contradicts itself: ADS1110 (description/spec/official I2C index) vs ADS1100 (comparison table).
Sampling rates: page description 15/30/60/240 SPS vs comparison table 8/16/32/128 SPS.
Reference: page description internal 2.048V vs spec table VDD reference; divider=100/610 has no page source.
Snapshot driver has a missing-call bug in get_voltage(); master fixed it.

claims: get_voltage conversion; snapshot missing-call bug fixed only in master

runtime.required_data_plane: SoC I2C controller transactions to a device-local ADS1110 register-file slave; 1-byte config write and 2-byte big-endian conversion read

units.blocker: Runtime implementation must anchor the master-fixed get_voltage() semantics (or patch the snapshot) and model ADS1110, not ADS1100. Chip identity, SPS set and reference voltage remain unresolved in the official documentation.
units.input_semantics: Synthetic input-voltage fixture inverse-encoded into a signed 16-bit ADC code using the driver formula.
units.output_semantics: Observed guest config writes and conversion reads; voltage is guest-side driver output.
limitations: All default values are synthetic UI/test fixtures, not measured hardware defaults.
This catalog entry alone does not authorize a simulated or functional-PASS claim.
ADC accuracy, PGA error, reference drift and 0-12V input divider tolerance are not modeled.

units.name: Unit ExtEncoder

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: STM32F030-based AB/ABZ encoder counter at 0x59. Registers: 0x00 counter int32le, 0x10 meter int32le, 0x20 meter ASCII, 0x30 reset write 1, 0x40 perimeter uint32le, 0x50 pulse uint32le, 0x60 zero-pulse uint32le, 0x70 zero mode uint8, 0xFE firmware, 0xFF address. Reads are register-pointer write followed by readfrom_into.
gaps: The product page protocol table renders corrupt in the fetched HTML; register semantics rest on the driver only.
0x20 ASCII meter format and 0x30 reset semantics (hardware counter vs driver base) are unresolved.
12-bit sampling accuracy and AB/ABZ decoding are not modeled.

claims: STM32F030F4P6, I2C 0x59, AB/ABZ (protocol table rendering corrupt)

runtime.required_data_plane: SoC I2C controller transactions to a device-local 256-byte register-file slave with pointer-write/read semantics and 0xFF address migration

units.blocker: Runtime implementation needs a CONTROL_EXTENCODER register-file branch (4-byte LE reads/writes, reset write, address migration). The corrupt product protocol table and the 0x20/0x30 semantics remain unresolved; AB/ABZ decoding is not modeled.
units.input_semantics: Synthetic counter/perimeter/pulse fixtures encoded into the model's register file.
units.output_semantics: Observed guest register reads/writes and address changes; encoder mechanics are not modeled.
limitations: All default values are synthetic UI/test fixtures, not measured hardware defaults.
This catalog entry alone does not authorize a simulated or functional-PASS claim.
AB/ABZ signal decoding, sampling accuracy, mechanical coupling and reset semantics are not modeled.

units.name: Unit ACSSR

protocol.summary: I2C mode at 0x50: write 0x00 1/0 for relay on/off and read back; write 0x10 3-byte big-endian RGB; write 0x20 to change address (driver then sleeps 5s); read 0xFE firmware. The unit also has Button and Modbus(RS485) modes not modeled here.
gaps: Product page has no I2C register table; the communication-protocol manual PDF was not read.
AC load electrical/switching behavior (24-480V, 10A, zero-cross, leakage, lifetime) is out of scope and must be a safety blocker.
Button and Modbus modes, and mode switching, are out of scope.
set_address() sleeps 5s; address migration semantics are unresolved.

claims: I2C 0x50, modes Button/I2C/Modbus, 3.3V logic, SK6812 RGB

runtime.required_data_plane: SoC I2C controller transactions to a device-local ACSSR register slave; relay state is model state only

units.blocker: Runtime implementation needs a CONTROL_ACSSR I2C branch (0x00 level, 0x10 RGB, 0x20 address, 0xFE firmware). AC electrical behavior is explicitly out of scope; the protocol manual and address-migration semantics remain unresolved. 0x50 conflicts with registered nfc (one Unit per bus).
units.input_semantics: No host input fixture for the relay itself; RGB and address are observed guest writes.
units.output_semantics: Observed guest-to-Unit relay/RGB/address writes and readback; AC load is not modeled.
limitations: All default values are synthetic UI/test fixtures, not measured hardware defaults.
This catalog entry alone does not authorize a simulated or functional-PASS claim.
AC mains safety, switching behavior, relay lifetime and RGB optics are not modeled; never treat this model as a mains-capable switch.

units.name: Unit AMeter

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: Two slaves: ADS1115 at 0x48 (conversion 0x00 read int16be; config 0x01 RW 16-bit: PGA bits14:12, rate bits7:5, mode bit8, OS bit15) and EEPROM at 0x51 with 8-byte factory calibration records at addresses 208/216/224/232/240/248 per gain (gain, expect int16be, real int16be, XOR of first 5 bytes in byte5). Current = resolution * calibration_factor * conversion * -1; resolution = mV_LSB / 0.05.

registers.config: 0x01, 2 bytes: OS bit15, mode bit8, rate bits7:5, PGA bits14:12

registers.calibration: gain blocks at 208/216/224/232/240/248, 8 bytes: gain, expect_be16, real_be16, xor

gaps: EEPROM factory calibration layout and XOR checksum come from the driver only; the page only says factory-calibrated and warns not to write.
Real factory coefficients are unavailable; fixtures must be synthetic.
Current sign/direction (MEASURING_DIR=-1) and the isolated measurement path are not modeled.
The page states 1% full-scale accuracy and 0.3mA resolution; those are not validated by this model.

runtime.required_data_plane: SoC I2C controller transactions to two device-local slaves (ADS1115 0x48 + EEPROM 0x51) under one Unit attachment; EEPROM read-only by default

units.blocker: Runtime implementation needs a multi-slave Unit attachment and a read-only EEPROM fixture; the real factory calibration record is unavailable. 1% accuracy, 0.3mA resolution, isolation and fuse behavior remain NOT RUN.
units.input_semantics: Synthetic current/ADC fixtures encoded into the ADS1115 conversion register; calibration record is a synthetic but checksum-valid EEPROM block.
units.output_semantics: Observed guest config/conversion transactions, EEPROM read block and rejected EEPROM writes; current is guest-side driver output.
limitations: All default values are synthetic UI/test fixtures, not measured hardware defaults.
This catalog entry alone does not authorize a simulated or functional-PASS claim.
Measurement accuracy, factory calibration authenticity, isolation, thermal drift and fuse behavior are not modeled.

units.name: Unit Gesture

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: PAJ7620U2 at 0x73. begin() selects bank 0 via 0xEF, reads part id from 0x00 (4 bytes, (b1<<8)|b0 must be 0x7620), then writes a 219-entry [reg,val] init array. get_gesture() reads 0x44 (4 bytes) and 0x43 (4 bytes); bits: Right 1<<0, Left 1<<1, Up 1<<2, Down 1<<3, Forward 1<<4, Backward 1<<5, Clockwise 1<<6, AntiClockwise 1<<7, Wave 1<<8.
gaps: Product page has no register table; the PAJ7620U2 datasheet was linked but not read; init array and flags come from the driver.
Driver has inconsistent _gesture_high_rate vs _gesture_highrate attribute names; low-rate branch is unreliable and out of scope.
Gesture recognition physics, IR optics, distance and ambient-light immunity are not modeled.

claims: gesture flag registers 0x43/0x44 and bit definitions

runtime.required_data_plane: SoC I2C controller transactions to a device-local PAJ7620 register-bank slave; 219 init writes accepted, part-id and flag registers driven by fixtures

units.blocker: Runtime implementation needs a US_PAJ7620 bank-aware register-file slave with a valid part-id response and fixture-driven gesture flags; the low-rate driver branch is buggy (attribute mismatch), and gesture optics/recognition are NOT RUN.
units.input_semantics: Synthetic gesture bitmask fixture encoded into the 0x43/0x44 flag bytes.
units.output_semantics: Observed guest init writes, bank switches and flag reads; recognized gesture is guest-side driver output.
limitations: All default values are synthetic UI/test fixtures, not measured hardware defaults.
This catalog entry alone does not authorize a simulated or functional-PASS claim.
IR optics, gesture recognition, ambient-light immunity, distance and 240Hz timing are not modeled.
